reply.text:
For most beginners, about 2 to 4 working sets per exercise is plenty. A common starting point is 3 sets of 8 to 12 reps with a weight that leaves you 2 or 3 reps in the tank. Across a week, that usually works out to roughly 8 to 12 hard sets per muscle group, spread over two or three sessions.

Beginners grow on surprisingly little, and doing more doesn't speed it up. It mostly adds soreness and makes the habit harder to keep, so start lower and add a set only once the current load feels easy for a couple of weeks.

If you'd like me to set up a program around your schedule, tell me how many days a week you can train.
